historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr (3.8%) lifted toward the order-book-backed momentum of FY2024-H1 FY2026 (revenue +5.2%, +10.8%, +10.0%; orders in hand RMB357bn = 1.3x revenue); decelerates to 2.5% terminal
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: 3-year revenue CAGR (7.0%) is roughly double the 3-year equity CAGR (3.6%): revenue re-accelerated in FY2023-FY2025 on the rail capex upcycle while book value compounds slowly because ~50% of attributable profit is paid out and 22% of profit accrues to NCI. 5-year figures (3.4-3.8%) are consistent across revenue, EPS and equity.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC is nil). Owner FCF: FY2018 9,236; FY2019 13,742; FY2020 -10,558; FY2021 13,863; FY2022 15,550; FY2023 5,450; FY2024 15,530; FY2025 13,602 (RMB m). The 5-year CAGR is undefined because FY2020 owner FCF was negative (COVID-year receivables build); the 7-year figure from FY2018 is reported instead. Owner FCF has grown slower than reported FCF because interest income on the rising cash pile (591m -> 1,201m) is a growing share of the reported figure.

scenario_narratives.base: Rail capex stays at the ~RMB900bn/yr level through the 15th Five-Year Plan and CRRC keeps its near-monopoly on mainline equipment for China State Railway Group (43.6% of revenue). Revenue grows 8% in FY2026 on the RMB357bn order book, then decelerates to 2.5% as new-build gives way to overhaul and the urban-rail market keeps shrinking under local-government debt limits. The new-industry segment (wind, PV inverters, storage) grows faster but at thinner margins, so the model EBITDA margin dips to 9.9% near term (management's stated pressure from R&D, pricing and incubation costs) before recovering to 10.4% on aftermarket mix. Overseas stays ~13-15% of revenue: Belt and Road and emerging-market locomotive orders offset exclusion from EU tenders. Working capital absorbs 10% of each year's revenue increase; combined tax + NCI leakage 32-33.5%.
scenario_narratives.bull: The 15th Five-Year Plan front-loads high-speed and freight renewal, the CR450 fleet-upgrade cycle starts within the horizon, and State Railway's overhaul-mileage reform lifts aftermarket volumes rather than cutting them. New-industry revenue compounds in the high teens with GW-scale offshore wind and top-3 inverter share, and the 'five-locals' localisation model keeps overseas orders growing at 20%+ outside the EU. Revenue grows 11% in FY2026 and 6%+ through FY2030; EBITDA margin expands to 11.5% on aftermarket and components mix. Working capital stays supplier-funded (6% capture). Requires the rail cycle, the new-energy margin and the overseas pipeline to all hold at once.
scenario_narratives.bear: The rail upcycle peaks in FY2026: after the plan's early-year deliveries, State Railway throttles new-build and extends overhaul/repair intervals (the policy change the company itself flags), urban-rail orders keep falling, and the wind-turbine price war compresses new-industry margins. Revenue stalls in FY2027 and falls 4% and 3% in FY2028-29 before recovering at 2%. State Railway uses its monopsony pricing leverage, taking the model EBITDA margin to 8.4%. EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation precedent (Bulgaria 2024, Lisbon Metro 2026) spreads to EU-aligned markets, capping overseas growth. Receivables and inventories keep building (15% capture; the H1 FY2026 -16.1bn OCF persists into the full year), and NCI partners in the growing new-energy subsidiaries take a larger profit share (leakage to 35%).

valuation_philosophy.summary: CRRC is valued as a mature, net-cash, SOE-controlled industrial whose cash flows accrue to shareholders only after a 22% NCI take and a 50% payout to a controlling parent's agenda. The component build strips interest income (cash is in the bridge), charges NCI once through a combined leakage rate, holds the share count flat (no SBC, no buybacks), and caps the terminal value at 12x owner FCF rather than the 15.8x Gordon implies at 9%/2.5%, because the stock's own history (3-6x EV/EBITDA, 8-15x P/E) says no buyer grants a compounder multiple to a single-customer rail supplier. Risk is carried in the flows and in a 30% bear weight, not in the discount rate. The H-share's 27.5% discount to the A-share is treated as the market's governance/SOE discount and is deliberately not modelled as an FX or value difference: the valuation is of the underlying RMB cash flows, converted at spot.
key_risks_to_valuation: Customer concentration: China State Railway Group 43.6% of FY2025 revenue (top 5 = 48.0%); a procurement-policy change (overhaul-cycle extension, price concessions) moves both the growth and margin paths at once
Working-capital drift: H1 FY2026 OCF -RMB16.1bn (vs -9.0bn); if the FY2026 full-year does not recover to the ~RMB20-25bn range the base-case 10% capture is too light

Terminal cap judgment: the 12x cap binds in every scenario; at 15x the base value is materially higher, and the whole gap to the Gordon value is the price of a re-rating that the H-share market has never granted

SOE governance and related-party consolidation (CRRC Zhicheng and Beijing Equipment acquired from parent in 2025) can divert cash to non-economic uses; the 50% payout ratio is policy, not a commitment
Overseas regulatory exclusion: EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation precedent could spread to other Western-aligned tenders, capping the only segment growing above 20%
FX: per-share value converts RMB to HKD at a dated spot rate (CNYHKD 1.1727, 2026-10-16); refresh_price.py moves the price but not the rate
New-energy margin: the wind-turbine price war and PV inverter competition could hold the segment at a structurally lower margin than rail equipment, diluting the group margin as the mix shifts

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (1766.HK) at inputs.price_as_of; HKEX regular close; 52-week range HK$4.42-6.76. CNYHKD=X from the same API, 2026-10-16. A-share 601766.SS used only as a parity check.
data_sources.financials: 1766.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, RMB millions) for FY2018-H1 FY2026 history; 1766.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt consolidated income statement (lines 6985-7022), balance sheet (6787-6885), cash-flow supplementary reconciliation (14277-14297) and EBITDA reconciliation (5263-5270); 1766.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt balance sheet (2116-2200), borrowings/bonds/notes disclosure (1049-1055) and Note V.37/V.40 (7301-7303, 7407-7411) for the 30 June 2026 debt, lease and cash anchors.
data_sources.qualitative: 1766.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-17): business model, customer concentration, 15th Five-Year Plan outlook, EU FSR actions, management guidance and bull/bear axes.

inputs.share_count_basis: 28,698.864m ordinary shares (A + H), unchanged FY2018-H1 FY2026; no options, convertibles or dilutive instruments (H1 FY2026 basic EPS = diluted EPS RMB0.28). Held flat.
inputs.total_debt_note: Company-stated total borrowings, bonds and notes RMB19,205m at 30 June 2026 (interim report, 'Borrowings, corporate bonds and notes') plus lease liabilities RMB3,179m (2,467 non-current + 712 due within one year, Note V.40). Excludes provisions and long-term payables that the parser's 'non-current liabilities due within one year' line bundles.
inputs.cash_note: Cash and bank balances at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 balance sheet). Includes restricted deposits backing bills payable; bills payable are treated as operating working capital, so the backing deposits are kept in cash for consistency. Seasonally depleted: FY2025 year-end balance was RMB67,835m before the H1 FY2026 working-capital build (OCF -16.1bn) and the final dividend. Large-deposit certificates in other current assets (RMB940m) excluded.
inputs.sbc_source: No share-based payment disclosed in FY2018-FY2025 annual reports (CRRC is a SASAC-controlled SOE with no equity-incentive scheme in the period). SBC-zero market: house and street bases coincide, band_position is null.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); H-share price in HKD. Per-share values computed in CNY and converted at CNYHKD 1.1727 (Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16). Parity check: the Shanghai A-share 601766.SS closed RMB6.38 on 2026-10-16 = HK$7.48 at this rate, against the H-share HK$5.42 -- a 27.5% A/H discount, which is the structural SOE A/H spread, not an FX-direction error (the direction is confirmed by HK$ > RMB per unit).
inputs.price_note: HKEX regular close 2026-10-16 (Friday); not an after-hours print. 52-week range HK$4.42-6.76.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: China 10-year CGB ~1.8% + equity risk premium 7.2% (mature-market 4.5% plus ~2.7pp China country risk) x beta 1.0 = 9.0% cost of equity. The group is net cash so WACC = cost of equity. No ad-hoc SOE/governance or customer-concentration premium is stacked on the rate: those risks are carried in the bear-case flows and in a 30% bear weight (charge risk once). Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt. Lease liabilities RMB3,179m included in total_debt; lease principal is not deducted from the flows; right-of-use depreciation (RMB817m FY2025) is inside the D&A line so EBIT is after it; lease interest sits in finance costs (a financing cost, excluded from EBITDA like debt interest). Ongoing lease-asset renewal is charged through capex_pct (~0.3pp of revenue added to the FY2025 cash capex ratio of 3.44%).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows made attributable-only: non-controlling interests took 22.0% of FY2025 net profit (RMB3,715m of 16,896m; 20.9% in FY2024). The cash_tax_rate_path is a COMBINED leakage rate = 1 - (1 - income tax rate) x (1 - NCI share): FY2025 effective tax 12.5% (high-tech 15% preferential rate net of R&D super-deduction) and NCI 22% give 31.7%, ramped to 33.5% as the tax rate normalises toward 15%. NCI book value (RMB43,556m) is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge. Calibration: FY0 model EBIT 18,527m x (1 - 0.32) = 12,598m vs reported attributable net income ex interest income 12,364m (within 2%).
inputs.ebitda_definition: Model EBITDA = operating profit 18,722m + interest expense 1,006m - interest income 1,201m + D&A 9,095m = 27,621m (10.12% of FY2025 revenue). It is AFTER credit-impairment (1,401m) and asset-impairment (924m) losses, which are recurring costs for a manufacturer carrying RMB126bn of receivables, and after R&D (17,641m, 6.5% of revenue). It includes other income (government grants/VAT refunds 2,762m) and associate income (728m), both recurring. The company's own EBITDA (29,420m) adds back interest income and includes non-operating items; the sanity-check multiples will therefore read ~6% richer than the model's.
inputs.working_capital_note: Year-end net operating working capital is roughly nil (FY2025: receivables 116.5 + bills 13.7 + contract assets 29.7 + inventories 95.1 = 255.0bn vs payables 162.6 + bills payable 67.2 + contract liabilities 34.3 = 264.1bn) because suppliers and bills payable fund the book, but the trend is adverse: inventories +21% and receivables +5% in FY2025, and the H1 FY2026 OCF of -16.1bn (vs -9.0bn in H1 FY2025) shows a deepening intra-year build. FY2021-FY2025 OCF ran ~RMB6bn below net profit + D&A on ~RMB47bn of revenue growth (~-13% capture, noisy). Base case charges 10% of each year's revenue increase as working-capital outflow; bear 15%; bull 6%.
inputs.base_year_note: FY0 = FY2025 (last audited full year). H1 FY2026 is not used as the FCF base: CRRC's cash collection is structurally H2/Q4-weighted (H1 FY2025 OCF -9.0bn became +24.2bn for the full year), so an interim FCF is not a run-rate. The H1 FY2026 deterioration is reflected in the bear-case working-capital capture and bear weight, and in the use of the seasonally depleted 30 June 2026 cash balance in the bridge (conservative).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted (dcf-methods routing: operating company, non-US, cyclical -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md). CRRC is a rolling-stock and new-energy equipment manufacturer whose value is a stream of free cash flow; it is not a bank, REIT or holdco, although it consolidates a group finance company (CRRC Finance) whose deposits/loans are small relative to the group. Adaptations applied: (a) CNY-built WACC and CNY->HKD quote conversion with A-share parity check; (b) one lease treatment (A); (c) NCI charged once via the combined leakage rate; (d) interest income stripped from the flows with the cash pile added back in the bridge (net cash RMB21.8bn vs owner-FCF base RMB13.6bn -> the strip is required); (e) SBC rows explicit at 0%, band collapsed; (f) risk charged once, in the flows and weights, not in the discount rate. Terminal cap 12x owner FCF: a mature, SOE-controlled, single-customer cyclical whose own H-share history is ~3-6x EV/EBITDA and 8-15x P/E; Gordon at 9%/2.5% would imply 15.8x, so the cap binds in every scenario. Fresh build: no prior DCF, Drivers or memory entry for this ticker.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +8% (H1 +10.0%, strong H2 FY2025 comparator, management 'steady increase'); order book 1.3x revenue supports FY2027 +6.5%; then decelerates through the 15th Five-Year Plan as the network approaches 180,000km and new-build gives way to overhaul/aftermarket; 2.5% terminal.
base.margin_rationale: FY0 model EBITDA margin 10.1%. Management explicitly flags short-term net-profit pressure from R&D, price competition and new-business incubation -> 9.9% in FY2026-27, then a slow 50bp recovery to 10.4% as aftermarket/overhaul mix and new-industry scale offset State Railway pricing leverage. No return to the FY2022-23 11% level.
base.cash_tax_rationale: Combined income-tax + NCI leakage on EBIT; see inputs.nci_treatment. Ramps 32% -> 33.5% as the effective tax rate drifts from 12.5% toward the 15% high-tech rate.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear lifted from the 15% house default to 30% for a single customer at 43.6% of revenue with monopsony pricing power, SOE capital allocation that sits behind state objectives (related-party acquisitions from CRRC Group, Party-committee governance), a precedent-setting EU exclusion, and a deteriorating intra-year cash profile (H1 FY2026 OCF -16.1bn vs -9.0bn). Bull cut to 25% because it needs three independent things to go right: a sustained rail capex plateau, new-energy margin stabilisation in a sector the company itself calls fiercely competitive, and continued overseas growth under widening security screening. Base 45%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
